name: stm32u585
description: ST STM32U585xI / U575xI (Cortex-M33 160 MHz, 2 MB dual-bank flash, 786 KB SRAM; the MCU of the Arduino UNO Q): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeU5 HAL/LL, Renode stm32u585 platform (boards NUCLEO-U575ZI-Q and B-U585I-IOT02A)

toolchain.notes: TrustZone off (TZEN = 0): build non-secure images like the Cube examples (Projects/NUCLEO-U575ZI-Q/Templates/STM32CubeIDE: STM32U575ZITXQ_FLASH.ld, startup_stm32u575zitxq.s). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_u575zi_q.repl (LD1 green PC7, LD2 blue PB7, LD3 red PG2, button sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton PC13) and platforms/boards/st/b_u585i_iot02a.repl (LED6 red PH6, LED7 green PH7, active low). U5 models: STM32U5_RCC (MSIS/HSI/HSE/PLL1 clock tree drives systick and timer clocks), STM32U5_PWR (VOS/boost, SMPS), STM32U5_FlashController (8 KB pages, two banks), STM32_Cache (ICACHE/DCACHE), STM32_RTCv3 (the RTC of U5/L5/G4/WB/WL: calendar at ck_spre, alarms, wake-up timer, time stamp on PC13), STM32_TAMP (tamper inputs, backup registers); EXTI, GPDMA, SPI and ADC4 are the STM32WBA models, ADC1 the STM32L5 one. GPDMA: linked lists (2D items too), data handling (padding, packing, byte/half-word exchange), hardware requests wired by REQSEL number (ADC1/4, DAC1, USARTs, LPUART1, timers). USARTs: FIFO mode with RX threshold/full interrupts and wake-up from Stop. Not modelled yet: OCTOSPI and the octal memories, AES/SAES/HASH/PKA/OTFDEC, CORDIC, FMAC, MDF/ADF, USB OTG, LPDMA/LPBAM, Standby wake-up. The IWDG examples' LSI measurement needs tools/stm32cube/fixtures/lsi_tim17_u5.repl. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeU5 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_u575.txt and examples_b_u585.txt in the Renode tree)
